references.text: When you pass through the waters, I am with you; and through the rivers, they shall not overwhelm you. When you walk through fire, you shall not be burned, and the flame shall not consume you.

Paulus gathered a bundle of sticks and laid them on the fire. A viper came out because of the heat and fastened itself to his hand. When the native people saw the snake hanging from his hand, they said to one another: 'Surely this man must be a murderer. Though he has been saved from the sea, justice has not allowed him to live.' But he shook the snake off into the fire and suffered no harm.

Through faith many heroes in the Bible performed miracles, overthrew kingdoms, practiced righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions, quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, were made strong out of weakness, became mighty in war, and put foreign armies to flight.
